b6_reason: O2+ has bond order 2.5 with one unpaired electron in pi*, so it is paramagnetic, not diamagnetic.
b6_working: O2+: 15 electrons, pi*2p holds 1 electron -> paramagnetic
b6_note: Source damage: sub/superscripts scrambled in options 1, 3, 4; read as O2+/O2/O2-/O2^2- and H2+. Confidence lowered.
